violated_contract: A test fixture that monkeypatches a production function must match the production call signature. On 2026-09-18, #14513 changed free_tier_local_processing_enabled to take (uid) but left 0-arg lambdas in test_free_tier_entrypoint_matrix.py, so 174 entrypoint-matrix cases raised TypeError at the mock boundary and Backend unit shard 4/4 went red on every open PR.
canonical_prevention: When a PR changes a mocked function's signature, grep the test tree for its monkeypatch sites in the same PR and update each lambda/fixture to accept the new arity; arg-tolerant lambdas (*args) are the minimal durable form for flag-style returns.
